title: mission-control-scene-view
description: The thin, READ-ONLY compositional projection behind the AWCMS 3D Mission Control workspace (issue #264, parent epic #263, ADR-0031). It is NOT an authority and NOT a second copy of any record: every node is a REFERENCE (source_kind + opaque source_id) to a record that an existing authority already owns (OMES host/deployment/job/health/backup evidence, Hermes orchestration observations per ADR-0028, the architecture registry per #247, the GitHub repository-progress projection per ADR-0030, the AI-privacy posture per ADR-0029, or an AWCMS workflow approval), plus a small bounded label/state/freshness/detail-route envelope. The mapping from node kind to authority, source contract, allowed fields, detail route, candidate actions and replay evidence lives in contracts/control-center/v1/mission-control-source-map.json, and visual_state MUST equal the deterministic function of (kind, source_state, freshness) that map defines (OMES guard MC8 checks every checked-in fixture). It carries no layout coordinates, no mission/task lifecycle, no authorization decision, no action availability, and no raw log/prompt/transcript/tool payload - additionalProperties=false at every object level makes that structural (registry guard C1 also forbids any command/cmd/shell/script/exec/argv property key). Server-side RBAC/ABAC/RLS decides what a viewer may see BEFORE this shape is produced; this schema describes only the wire shape.

schema_version.description: This contract's own version. A consumer MUST reject an unknown major version (fail closed).

source_map_version.description: The mission-control-source-map.json version whose state map produced visual_state. A consumer MUST reject a source-map version it does not have vendored.

tenant_id.description: The single tenant this composition was authorized and assembled for. Every node and relation belongs to this tenant; a composition never spans tenants.

generated_at.description: When the composing system (AWCMS) assembled this view.

mode.description: live = the latest retained observation of every source; historical = the state each source's retained evidence proves at as_of (issue #266). A historical view MUST be rendered so it cannot be mistaken for live state, and exposes no actions.

as_of.description: The instant this view describes. Equals generated_at in live mode; the replay cursor in historical mode.

sources.description: One entry per source the composition consulted, so a viewer can see which authority is behind each zone and whether it was reachable. A source that could not be read is reported here as unavailable - its nodes are then absent or carry freshness unknown, never silently replaced by a healthy empty state.

status.description: available = read successfully and fresh; stale = read, but its newest observation is older than the source's freshness budget; unavailable = could not be read (error, not configured, or permission-limited to nothing).

observed_at.description: The newest observation timestamp the source supplied, or null when unavailable/never observed.

nodes.description: Scene objects. Each is a reference to exactly one record owned by the source named in the source map for its kind.

node_id.description: An opaque handle unique WITHIN this response, used only by relations. Consumers MUST NOT parse it or treat it as a cross-system identifier.

source_id.description: The source authority's own opaque identifier for the referenced record (e.g. a server_id, job id, Hermes subagent_id, capability_id, milestone number). Echoed verbatim; never synthesized from other fields.

label.description: Bounded display label taken from an allowed field of the source record. UNTRUSTED: consumers MUST output-encode it and MUST NOT inject it as HTML.

source_state.description: The source record's own state value, echoed verbatim from the field the source map names (e.g. RUNNING, succeeded, degraded, PASS, staged). 'not_reported' when the source does not report one.

visual_state.description: Deterministic presentation class = source-map state_map[kind][source_state] adjusted by freshness (unknown -> unknown; stale -> stale unless the mapped class is failed or warning). Never inferred from animation.

observed_at.description: When the source last observed this record; null when it never has.

detail_route.description: The canonical EXISTING 2D surface for this record (source map 'detail_route' for the kind, optionally with a bounded query selecting the record). Never a new 3D-only page.

summary.description: Optional bounded, already-sanitized summary from an allowed source field (e.g. a Hermes node's summary). UNTRUSTED; output-encode. Never a prompt, transcript, reasoning trace, or tool argument/result.

relations.description: Observable links between nodes. Each relation must be backed by a field in a source record (named in the source map's relation vocabulary); a relation never implies authority or causality the source does not prove.

truncated.description: Whether the bounded node/relation limits dropped anything. A truncated view MUST say so visibly rather than imply the scene is complete.

nodes.description: Number of nodes omitted by the size bound (0 when complete).

evidence_gaps.description: Historical mode only (issue #266): intervals where a source retained no evidence. A gap is shown as a gap, never interpolated into a state.
